editorial.tldr: Moonshot AI shipped Kimi K3 on Jul 16 — a 2.8-trillion-parameter model available via website and API, with an open-weight release still pending. Simon Willison's first look sanity-checked it against his running pelican benchmark before wider benchmark claims arrived the next day.
editorial.whats_new: Jul 17 coverage from Tom's Hardware, Decrypt, Bloomberg, and the Washington Post reports Kimi K3 beating Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on benchmarks, with Bloomberg calling it a new "DeepSeek moment" for Chinese open-weight labs.
editorial.why_it_matters: A credible frontier-scale open-weight contender narrows the price/performance gap with Claude and GPT — worth a bake-off before defaulting to a closed-model API for cost-sensitive workloads once weights or stable hosted access land.
editorial.take_for_builders: Before swapping a workload onto Kimi K3, run your own eval rather than trusting the press benchmark claims — Tom's Hardware's Frontend Code Arena result is a vendor-selected single benchmark, not a published independent leaderboard, and no open weights exist yet to self-host and verify.

status.detail: Kimi K3 shipped via API on Jul 16; next-day coverage claims it beats Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on benchmarks, though an open-weight release hasn't landed yet.
